## What I actually work on
:::

[Most data science writing is about models. Comparatively little is about **the messy, regulated, consequential systems models get deployed into** — where a wrong number becomes a wrong investment, and a regulator will ask you to show your working. That is the part I find interesting, and it is what I write about.]{.lede}

::: {.areas}
::: {.area}
[Asset risk]{.tag}

### Risk on real networks

Turning an asset register into a defensible view of risk — what the data actually supports, where it is thin, and what follows for spend.
:::
::: {.area}
[AI strategy]{.tag}

### AI that survives contact

Setting a direction for AI in an organisation that has to answer to a regulator — less about capability, more about evidence, assurance and sequencing.
:::
::: {.area}
[Decision science]{.tag}

### Decisions, not dashboards

Optimisation and scenario modelling aimed at a decision someone has to make, rather than a chart someone has to look at.
:::
:::

::: {.pullquote}
A few are probably wrong — but hopefully interesting in the attempt.
